en.title: Ted Lasso Officially Kicks Off 2026 FIFA World Cup in LA
en.summary: Jason Sudeikis's beloved soccer coach made a surprise appearance to welcome the world to the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The cameo signals a major role for the character heading into the tournament.
en.body:
The roar of the crowd wasn't just for the athletes at the 2026 FIFA World Cup opening ceremony in Los Angeles. In a move that delighted fans and signaled a significant endorsement for the sport's growing popularity in the U.S., **Jason Sudeikis** reprised his iconic role as **Ted Lasso** to welcome the world to the greatest tournament on Earth.

Sudeikis, embodying the relentlessly optimistic and endearingly unqualified AFC Richmond manager, took center stage before the tournament's kickoff. This appearance wasn't just a fleeting cameo; it marks **Ted Lasso**'s official integration into the FIFA World Cup 2026 festivities. The character's journey from a small-town American football coach to an English Premier League icon has mirrored soccer's own surge in mainstream American appeal, and his presence at the opening ceremony is a testament to that crossover success. Fans have grown to love Lasso's unique blend of folksy wisdom and unwavering belief, qualities that resonate deeply with the spirit of global competition.

## Lasso's World Cup Game Plan

Beyond the opening ceremony, **Ted Lasso**'s involvement with the 2026 FIFA World Cup is set to be extensive. Reports confirm that **Sudeikis**, in character, will be a visible presence throughout the tournament, appearing in official World Cup commercials and engaging in various promotional events. This multi-faceted approach ensures that the **Ted Lasso** brand, and by extension the sport itself, remains top of mind for a global audience. The timing couldn't be more perfect, as the highly anticipated fourth season of the **Ted Lasso** series is slated to follow the tournament, offering viewers a chance to dive back into the world of AFC Richmond with the World Cup still fresh in their minds. This synergistic approach is a masterclass in leveraging popular culture to amplify a major sporting event.

## What This Means for Fans

For the millions of **Ted Lasso** fans worldwide, this is more than just a celebrity endorsement; it's a validation of the show's impact. The character’s journey has inspired many, proving that kindness and belief can overcome formidable odds, a message that perfectly aligns with the underdog spirit often celebrated in sports. Seeing **Ted Lasso** officially welcomed into the World Cup fold provides a sense of continuity and excitement, bridging the gap between the fictional narrative they adore and the real-world drama unfolding on the pitch. It suggests that the lessons and heart of **Ted Lasso** are being recognized on a global stage, making the upcoming season feel even more significant.

## What's Next

With **Ted Lasso** now officially a part of the 2026 FIFA World Cup experience, fans can eagerly anticipate seeing him in various capacities throughout the tournament. The character's expanded role, including commercials and events, will keep the momentum going until the highly anticipated fourth season of the show premieres later this year.

content_raw: Sudeikis had a surprise cameo during the first-ever World Cup Final halftime show, weeks before 'Ted Lasso' returns with season four in August.
